company.summary: ANDØYA SPACE AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under forskning og eksperimentell utvikling innenfor naturvitenskap og teknikk (NACE 72.100), based in Andøy, founded 1997-07-09. Its verified website describes it as: “Andøya Space is an aerospace company which enables scientists, engineers, students and government entities to achieve mission success.” Public brand: Andoya Space. Registered activity: Leverandør av infrastrukturtjenester til aktivitet innen romforskning, miljørelatert forskning og overvåkning, teknologitesting samt romrelatert undervisning i Norge. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 178.6 m, operating result NOK -8.2 m, net result NOK 21.8 m, total assets NOK 930.1 m, equity NOK 314.5 m. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 151.8 m to NOK 178.6 m (+18%); net result went from NOK 7.3 m to NOK 21.8 m (+198%); equity went from NOK 292.7 m to NOK 314.5 m (+7%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin -4.6%; equity ratio 33.8%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 166. Leadership in the official register: Ketil Olsen (managing director); Ragnvald Rasmus Sunde (chair of the board); Heidi Nag Flikka (board member); Even Aas (board member); plus 7 further roles. 3 registered workplaces in Andenes, Oslo, Tromsø. Official website https://andoyaspace.no/ (identity check: legal name and registered phone); company-linked profiles on facebook, linkedin, x. Latest company-published activity: “Andøya Space søker lokaler i Andenes havn” (2026-10-07). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
